initial_inventory.title: Serve GLM 5.3 Flash and Qwen3.8 Flash Next GGUF across seven heterogeneous GPUs

metadata.title: Serve GLM 5.3 Flash and Qwen3.8 Flash Next GGUF across seven heterogeneous GPUs
metadata.body:
## Summary

Add and validate heterogeneous seven-stage pipeline serving for GLM 5.3 Flash and Qwen3.8 Flash Next GGUF models. The branch includes model-specific GGUF/MTP/multimodal adapters, PP batching and feedback changes, GLM sparse/indexer/MoE improvements, tracing, tests, and deployment guidance. It merges upstream `main` at `6a143197e6e5f6fa77bd483df0c5a09dcea6aa20`.

Detailed design, test methods, and limits: `docs/deployment/glm_qwen_heterogeneous_benchmark_20261024.md` and `docs/deployment/heterogeneous_pp7.md`.

## Experimental machine

Ubuntu 22.04 / Linux 6.8; two AMD EPYC 7763 CPUs (256 logical CPUs), 251 GiB RAM; four V100 32 GiB (SM70), two RTX 3090 24 GiB (SM86), one RTX 4090 48 GiB (SM89). TP1 × PP7, `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1`. GPU6 is limited to 100 W and 950 MHz. Qwen uses a `8,5,5,8,8,2,12` PP split and GLM uses `9,4,4,5,7,7,9`. Both systemd services share all seven GPUs and are mutually exclusive. Weights and machine-local binaries are not committed.

## Validation

- 217 targeted tests passed for touched KV cache, GGUF, SM70, MRoPE, DCP, TurboQuant, and FlashNext paths; merge pre-commit checks passed.
- Qwen GGUF Q4_K_XL, MTP4, 215040 context, eight sequences: three eight-lane rounds finished 8/8. Two warm rounds averaged 43.255 s and 265.550 shared-decode token/s; pooled MTP acceptance was 43.88%, with no preemptions. Relative to the same pre-merge configuration, these two samples show +5.29% wall time and -7.28% shared decode, insufficient for a stable regression claim. Long-prefix cache hits remained 423392 tokens/round. Short MTP, three concurrent requests and two-image API request passed.
- GLM GGUF IQ4_XS, MTP4, 163840 context, three sequences: 29/29 startup warmup cases, short MTP, three concurrent requests, two-image API request, and a 160000-token input plus 32-token output passed. The long request took 184.516 s.
- On the promoted merged-source services, Qwen accepted 45 draft tokens in a 64-token text smoke request and returned 30 tokens for a two-image chat request. GLM completed startup warmup, accepted 50 draft tokens in a 64-token text smoke request and returned 32 tokens for a two-image chat request. The GLM LAN proxy returned HTTP 200 for `/health` and `/v1/models`. Qwen remains configured and inactive for switching.

The isolated repeated 3000-token Qwen prefix assertion did not increment cache-hit metrics; it is shorter than two 1616-token cache pages. Visual response semantics were not evaluated. The upstream merge changed no native sources, so 16 existing native extensions were reused; no fresh native rebuild or full repository test suite was run.

## Duplication and assistance

I checked open PRs in this repository for heterogeneous PP7 / GLM GGUF / Qwen3.8 seven-GPU work and found no matching open PR. This contribution was prepared with AI assistance (OpenAI Codex); the measurements and machine state above come from actual tests on the stated server.
